questions.question_english: What is the long-term effect of mandating age- appropriate admission for out-of-school children?

questions.explanation_english: Section 14(2) explicitly provides that no child shall be denied admission to an educational institution solely due to the absence of documentary age proof. questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C है। धारा 14 का उद्देश्य यह सुनिश्चित करना है कि आयु का दस्तावेज न होने के कारण कोई बच्चा प्रारंभिक शिक्षा से वंचित न रहे। विद्यालय को उपयुक्त प्रक्रिया अपनाकर बच्चे को प्रवेश देना चाहिए। अधिनियम अनिवार्य अस्थि-परीक्षण, आश्रय-गृह में भेजने या वैध दस्तावेज मिलने तक प्रवेश रोकने की शर्त नहीं लगाता।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) No child shall be denied school admission for lacking age proof.

Section 14(2) explicitly provides that no child shall be denied admission to an educational institution solely due to the absence of documentary age proof. In cases where official birth certificates or civil registration records are unavailable, schools must accept alternative declarations or estimates to guarantee immediate, unobstructed access to elementary education for every child.

questions.question_english:
Consider the following infrastructure norms laid down in the Schedule of the RTE Act:
I. All-weather building consisting of at least one classroom for every teacher.
II. Separate toilets for boys and girls.
III. Safe and adequate drinking water facility to all children. Which of the above are mandatory requirements for a school to be recognized?
options_english: I and II
II and III
I and III
I, II and III
questions.explanation_english: Mandatory physical infrastructure norms under the Schedule include providing an all-weather school building with at least one classroom per teacher, an office-cum-store room, separate functional toilets for boys and girls, safe, adequate drinking water facilities, a kitchen for mid-day meals, a playground, and appropriate boundary wall or fencing arrangements.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर I, II और III है। RTE अनुसूची विद्यालयों के लिए बुनियादी संरचनात्मक मानक निर्धारित करती है, जिनमें सभी मौसमों में उपयोग योग्य भवन, कक्षा-कक्ष, अलग शौचालय और सुरक्षित पेयजल जैसी सुविधाएँ शामिल हैं। ये सुविधाएँ केवल वांछनीय सुधार नहीं, बल्कि विद्यालय की मान्यता और न्यूनतम कार्य-स्थितियों से जुड़ी आवश्यकताएँ हैं।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (D) I, II and III

Mandatory physical infrastructure norms under the Schedule include providing an all-weather school building with at least one classroom per teacher, an office-cum-store room, separate functional toilets for boys and girls, safe, adequate drinking water facilities, a kitchen for mid-day meals, a playground, and appropriate boundary wall or fencing arrangements.

questions.question_english: For a school to provide inclusive education effectively, the RTE Act requires barrier-free access. Which facilities best demonstrate such access?
options_english: Ramps, handrails and accessible toilets for students with disabilities
Round-the-clock armed security personnel at the entrance
Free daily bus transport for every student, irrespective of need
High-speed Wi-Fi and digital smart classrooms in every room
questions.explanation_english: Ramps, handrails, and accessible toilets for disabled students. Barrier-free access under the Schedule mandates physical architectural adaptations in school infrastructure. This includes constructing non- slip ramps with appropriate slopes, installing supportive handrails along corridors, and maintaining accessible toilet cubicles, enabling students with physical disabilities or mobility impairments to navigate school premises safely and independently.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर रैम्प, रेलिंग और सुलभ शौचालय है। बाधा-मुक्त पहुँच का उद्देश्य दिव्यांग बच्चों को विद्यालय भवन और आवश्यक सुविधाओं तक सुरक्षित तथा स्वतंत्र पहुँच देना है। रैम्प, रेलिंग और सुलभ शौचालय भौतिक बाधाएँ कम करते हैं। सशस्त्र सुरक्षा, सभी बच्चों के लिए बस सेवा या स्मार्ट-क्लास तकनीक अपने आप में बाधा-मुक्त पहुँच का अर्थ नहीं है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) Ramps, handrails and accessible toilets for students with disabilities

Ramps, handrails, and accessible toilets for disabled students. Barrier-free access under the Schedule mandates physical architectural adaptations in school infrastructure. This includes constructing non- slip ramps with appropriate slopes, installing supportive handrails along corridors, and maintaining accessible toilet cubicles, enabling students with physical disabilities or mobility impairments to navigate school premises safely and independently.

questions.question_english: What is the penalty prescribed under Section 18 of the RTE Act for establishing or running a school without obtaining a certificate of recognition?
options_english: Fine up to Rs 10,000 and Rs 500 for each day during which contravention continues
Fine up to Rs 50,000 and Rs 5,000 for each day during which contravention continues
Fine up to Rs 1,00,000 and Rs 10,000 per day for continuing contravention
Mandatory imprisonment up to 1 year along with immediate closure of school premises
questions.explanation_english: Section 19(5) stipulates that any person who establishes or runs a school without obtaining a certificate of recognition, or continues to run a school after withdrawal of recognition, shall be liable to a fine extending up to one lakh rupees, and ten thousand rupees for every day during which contravention continues.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर विकल्प C है। धारा 18 के अनुसार मान्यता के बिना विद्यालय चलाना निषिद्ध है और इसके लिए अधिकतम ₹1,00,000 तक जुर्माना तथा उल्लंघन जारी रहने पर प्रत्येक दिन के लिए ₹10,000 तक अतिरिक्त जुर्माना निर्धारित है। उद्देश्य यह है कि विद्यालय आवश्यक मानकों और वैधानिक मान्यता के बिना बच्चों को शिक्षा न दें।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Fine up to Rs 1,00,000 and Rs 10,000 per day for continuing contravention

Section 19(5) stipulates that any person who establishes or runs a school without obtaining a certificate of recognition, or continues to run a school after withdrawal of recognition, shall be liable to a fine extending up to one lakh rupees, and ten thousand rupees for every day during which contravention continues.

questions.question_english: The Head of a School is reviewing the student- teacher ratio for classes 6 to 8. Total enrollment is 140. Apart from one teacher each for Science/ Math, Social Studies, and Languages, the school must have:
options_english: A full-time head teacher and part-time instructors for Art, PE, and Work Education.
A part-time head teacher combined with dedicated full-time instructors for all non- academic extracurriculars.
A total of five regular subject teachers operating the upper primary section with no designated head teacher.
A total of four regular subject teachers operating the upper primary section with no designated head teacher.
questions.explanation_english: Under Schedule norms for upper primary classes (Classes 6-8), when total enrollment exceeds 100 students, the institution must provide a full-time Head Teacher alongside part-time instructors for Art Education, Health and Physical Education, and Work Education, in addition to core subject teachers.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर पूर्णकालिक प्रधान शिक्षक और कला, शारीरिक शिक्षा तथा कार्य शिक्षा के लिए अंशकालिक प्रशिक्षक हैं। उच्च प्राथमिक स्तर पर विषय-शिक्षकों के अलावा विद्यालय के संचालन के लिए प्रधान शिक्षक की व्यवस्था होती है। अनुसूची में कला शिक्षा, स्वास्थ्य एवं शारीरिक शिक्षा और कार्य शिक्षा जैसे क्षेत्रों के लिए निर्धारित नामांकन के अनुसार अंशकालिक प्रशिक्षकों की व्यवस्था का प्रावधान भी है।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A full-time head teacher and part-time instructors for Art, PE, and Work Education.

Under Schedule norms for upper primary classes (Classes 6-8), when total enrollment exceeds 100 students, the institution must provide a full-time Head Teacher alongside part-time instructors for Art Education, Health and Physical Education, and Work Education, in addition to core subject teachers.
